support_boundaries.scope: Clean wheel and sdist consumers on Windows, Linux, and macOS
support_boundaries.blocker: Clean-installed consumer rehearsals have not passed on every candidate platform.

support_boundaries.scope: Core installation and deterministic retrieval without LanceDB
support_boundaries.blocker: The package boundary and clean core-only installation test are not implemented.

support_boundaries.scope: Operator, contributor, source, limitation, and support documentation
support_boundaries.blocker: Stable support ownership, response expectations, and platform policy are not yet qualified.

limitations.statement: Python 3.14 is authoritative; Mojo is experimental and has no promoted runtime kernel.
limitations.user_impact: Users must not rely on Mojo for a capability or performance guarantee.

limitations.statement: Catalogued sources without live receipts do not establish current, complete, or lawful production data.
limitations.user_impact: Global coverage metrics describe source discovery and local capability, not global medicine completeness.

limitations.statement: Regulatory approval and funding remain separate evidence dimensions.
limitations.user_impact: Absence from one dimension cannot be interpreted as absence from the other.

limitations.statement: No stable publication is authorized while licence and release approvals are unresolved.
limitations.user_impact: Qualification artifacts are internal evidence contracts, not public release authorization.

residual_risks.description: Independent production backup storage, RPO, RTO and crash consistency are not qualified.
Renovate App activation requires maintainer authority.
Software and dataset licence approvals are unresolved.
Mojo remains experimental; Python 3.14 is authoritative.
